title: [scatter_add cutedsl] Use post-build TI strides for any dim eligibility
body:
Stack from [ghstack](https://github.com/ezyang/ghstack/tree/0.15.0) (oldest at bottom):
* __->__ #184604
* #184603

Generalize the override from `dim=0` only to any `dim` whose layout
fits the kernel after `TensorIterator` coalescing. Mirrors aten's
pattern in `ScatterGatherKernel.cu`: restride `self` so its
scatter-axis stride is 0 with shape matching `index`, build a
`TensorIterator`, and pattern-match the post-coalesce iter strides
against the kernel's expected layout (the same predicate aten's
`fast_scatter_add_kernel_eligible` uses in `IndexKernelUtils.h`).
`TensorIterator` does the layout analysis; we just consume the
result.

Default-contiguous tensors with `dim != 0` still fall through
(post-restride iter strides don't match the fast-path pattern);
pre-transposed views like `x.transpose(0, 1)` with `dim=1` are
now accepted.

Builds on the kwargs-style `TensorIterator` introduced in the
preceding commit.

Authored by Claude.
